en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large four‑storey brick school or institutional building with decorative stone bands and a steep tiled roof topped by ornate dormers and finials. Children and a few adults are gathered and walking along the wide street in front of the building and on the sidewalk by a fenced grass embankment. A smaller villa‑like building stands further down the straight road. In the background are open fields and gentle hills, giving a semi‑rural European town impression. The architecture is late‑19th‑century Central European, and some faint, small plaques with unreadable lettering are mounted on the façade.
